whys.heading: 5 Whys
whys.guide.title: How it works
whys.guide.what: 5 Whys challenges what you wrote: an AI asks “why?” about your notes, again and again, until you reach the root of it. Use any AI chat you like; this app calls no AI.
whys.guide.step1: Press Add, pick the prompt language and copy the prompt. Paste it into a new chat (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini…). It holds your title, notes, links and earlier sessions.
whys.guide.step2: The AI asks one “why” at a time. Answer it in the chat, in your own words.
whys.guide.step3: After each answer the AI digs deeper by itself. Type {deeper} to make it dig into your last answer, or {next} to challenge another point of your notes.
whys.guide.step4: When you are done, type {end}. The AI sums the session up as JSON.
whys.guide.step5: Copy its whole reply, paste it under step 2, check the preview and save. Later you can edit every why, or the JSON itself.
whys.guide.tree: In the tree, a deeper why sits under the why it digs into; a new point starts a new top-level why.

review.help: Spaced repetition, up to 6 “dig deeper” and 2 “link these?” cards a day. Notes you haven't dug into much ask for another 5 Whys round; well-dug notes that aren't linked are suggested as pairs. Cards you didn't get to stay for the next day. Done brings a card back later (1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 120 days); Again starts it over.
